notes: LOCALE: everything below was read from the UK storefront at https://www.anthropologie.com/en-gb/ . Confirmed UK, not US: all prices render in GBP, the GB top nav has a standalone 'Furniture' department (the US site folds it into 'Home & Furniture'), and every URL recorded is under /en-gb/. No US-only sibling rows were used. ACCESS: Claude-in-Chrome connector only (own tab), no HTTP/proxy route. robots.txt (read in-tab) has 'User-agent: * / Allow: /' with no ClaudeBot/anthropic-ai/Claude-Web disallow; only /api/, /orchestration/, /*search? and homepage paths are disallowed, none of which were used. TREE: taken from the GB 'Furniture' mega-nav flyout (opened in the live tab) and cross-checked against https://www.anthropologie.com/en-gb/categories_sitemap.xml (1095 GB category slugs; 68 matched furniture keywords). The Furniture flyout is FLAT - it has no second level - so every furniture node below is a leaf and no grouping rows exist. QTY: each count is the site's own rendered listing header ('N products'), which this platform server-renders and repeats 3x on the page (H1 area, filter bar, results re-statement). Every count was read TWICE in separate passes and was identical both times (no drift). SANITY CHECKS: counts differ per category (not a site-wide constant); the canonical URL and H1 of every page were verified to match the category actually requested - this mattered, because bad slugs on this platform silently serve the PARENT listing instead of 404ing (e.g. /en-gb/furniture-benches returns 200 with H1 'Furniture' and canonical /en-gb/furniture, and /en-gb/furniture-side-tables redirects to the homepage). Both were rejected. Numbers are small and non-round, so no display cap. EXCLUDED from the Furniture nav: Lighting (/en-gb/home-lighting) and Mirrors (/en-gb/decor-mirrors) - the Furniture department cross-lists them (its Product Type facet shows Lighting 166, Mirrors 94 inside the 648 total) but both are out of scope. Also excluded as §3 navigation junk: All Furniture (/en-gb/furniture), New In (/en-gb/new-furniture), Top-Rated (/en-gb/top-rated-furniture), Furniture under GBP 500 (price filter), Statement Furniture (/en-gb/pattern-mixing-curation, a curation), and the whole 'Shop by Room' column (shop-by-room-bedroom / -living-room / -dining-room / -bathroom / -office-curation / -small-spaces-curation / -uni-room-curation) which are room 'shop the look' landing pages. /en-gb/furniture-living-room, /en-gb/furniture-bedroom and /en-gb/furniture-dining-room exist in the sitemap but are contentless landing pages that publish no product count at all - skipped. Excluded from the Home & Decor nav: 'Shelves & Storage' (/en-gb/room-wall-decor-shelves) - it sits under the Wall Decor branch and is wall shelves/ledges, not furniture, per the shelving line. DUPLICATES DROPPED (kept the mega-nav URL, dropped the SEO twin): /en-gb/furniture-table-dining-table (H1 'Dining Tables', 14 - same concept and same count as the nav's /en-gb/furniture-tables) and /en-gb/coffee-tables (H1 'Coffee Tables', 22 - near-twin of the nav's /en-gb/furniture-coffee-tables, 23). /en-gb/sofa-two-seater (H1 'Two-Seater Sofas', 13) is a partial subtype page of Sofas with no sibling three-seater/corner category, so Sofas is kept as the leaf rather than splitting it. NOTE ON OVERLAP: this site cross-lists heavily (Armchairs 45 and Chairs 90 share products; Desks 5 also appears inside Storage's 'Desk (4)' item-type facet), so the leaf counts must not be summed. VERIFIED COMPOSITION: the Storage node (119) was opened and its Item Type facet read - Cabinet 47, Console Table 13, Sideboard 13, Bedside Table 11, Chest of Drawers 11, Dressing Table 10, Dresser 7, Bookshelf 6, Desk 4, Vanity 4, Drinks Cabinet 3, Side Table 2, Media Consoles 1 - i.e. genuine storage FURNITURE, not standalone baskets/boxes, so it is included.
